text:
Maria (AE): Hi team — passing Saffron Health to CS. Contract signed yesterday; they want Private (VPC) with dedicated capacity. Go-live target: 2024-05-15 (approx 3 weeks). Renewal: 11 months. Main asks: SSO (Okta), private data connector to their Snowflake, embeddings + dedup workflow, and lower tail latency for short chats.
Jake (CSM): Thanks Maria. Quick Qs: do they need pilot tokens or immediate Dedicated sizing? Also any known compliance docs?
Maria (AE): Pilot credit for first 2 weeks yes. Sales shared SOC2 summary and an export of their security questionnaire (I uploaded to the deal). Key constraint: infra team requires E2E encryption and KMS integration.
Tara (Onboarding PM): I'll own provisioning & kickoffs. Owner: Tara. Tasks: 1) collect Okta SAML metadata (owner: Saffron IT, sec: Maria), 2) request Snowflake read role (owner: Olivia/SE), 3) staging private cluster config (owner: Tara + eng infra), 4) run sample ingestion test and embedding dedup demo (owner: Olivia).
Olivia (SE): I'll take the Snowflake connector and embedding dedup pipeline. Need sample schema + a 50k row CSV (they said prepared). Can Saffron share a trimmed sample to slack/email? Tagging @Maria.
Maria (AE): I already requested sample; they said "can share sanitized extract by EOD tomorrow".
Liam (Support Eng): We'll monitor during provisioning and be on call for the first 48h after go-live. I need contact for their SRE + a preferred escalation channel (pager/email). Also: are there any expected spike windows?
Jake (CSM): Saffron expects heavy batch ingestion on Tuesdays (ET morning) for daily refresh. Risk: if deduping takes long, token cost + latency could spike. Suggest canary with smaller batch first.
Tara (Onboarding PM): Agreed — plan: 1) staging import (week1), 2) dedup canary (week2), 3) private cluster validation & performance tests (week3). I'll add owners & dates into the onboarding tracker.
Olivia (SE): Technical notes for ENG: recommend quantized model variant for embeddings to reduce memory, and prefix caching for short-chat flows. I'll draft config: `model: embed-v2-q4_8b`, `batch_size: 512 -> tune`, `kv_cache_enabled: true`.
Liam (Support Eng): I'll create the support ticket after staging is provisioned: template will include # of GPUs, model variant, expected QPS, and contact info. Please ping me when staging creds are ready.
handoff-bot: Handoff checklist created: provisioning, okta, snowflake, sample ingestion, canary plan, support ticket. Link: https://redwood/internal/handoffs/1766223344
Jake (CSM): Next steps owners recap: Tara (runbook + cluster), Olivia (connector + dedup), Liam (support ticket + oncall), Maria (customer comms + docs). Next sync scheduled: 2024-04-22 11:00 PT.
Maria (AE): Thanks all — I'll confirm sample delivery and SSO metadata. :thumbsup:
